answer_quotes.exact_quote: - **Actual CPU utilization.** Pool size caps how many tasks from that pool can run concurrently; it doesn't guarantee parallelism. Task granularity and striping can leave workers without work (e.g., PQ chunks are striped over `pool_count` workers — if `num_chunk_` < pool count, extra workers get nothing, pq_int8_quantizer.cc:332-341), stages synchronize at barriers and wait loops (diskann_builder.cc:317-336; pq_int8_quantizer.cc:356), `min()` clamps can shrink effective concurrency below the pool size (index.cc:1438-1439), and virtual-dispatch means an implementation may ignore the pool it was handed. Utilization is therefore workload- and implementation-dependent, not fixed by these settings.
